title: Is the guidance on Maximum Upload Size still current?

question.author: member_226
question.body: I found an older discussion about maximum upload size. Can someone confirm the current CloudBox behavior?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Storage Limits documentation says: The web app has a separate, smaller limit: files uploaded through a browser are capped at 2 GB. If a web upload fails near 2 GB, switch to the desktop client — this is expected behavior, not a bug. The 20 GB desktop limit was introduced in CloudBox 2.0 (September 2023); earlier versions were limited to 5 GB. Uploads that exceed the limit fail with the error "File too large". That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
